reviews.title: P2U
reviews.text: As the title says, it’s totally pay-to-use. The themes are cute, but it’s very difficult to actually use them unless you pay. Icons are pay-to-use, widgets are pay-to-use (even though the whole point of the app is the widget feature and the background feature. But whatever). I had to watch ads to unlock the widgets just to find out I couldn’t even download them—really? Anyways, you also have to watch 1-2 ads just to download backgrounds (and the background didn’t even download into my gallery when I did it twice), and you get an extra ad when you just start the app up. Annoyingly ad ridden.

reviews.title: Confusing and expensive
reviews.text: How do you even set up a theme?? there is literally no explanation. You can’t even go to settings without having to watch an add. You can’t open the app without it prompting you to pay and then having to watch another ad. I might actually pay if I could figure out how to even use this. I tried downloading a single widget with the limited gems you get to start off with and it won’t let me add it. And yes I did it the way the tutorial describes. It’s there but you can’t click it. I would pay if I could set up a full theme. i already customize for free by using short cuts and picking icon photos. But having fun widgets or a full theme I could easily set up. I wouldn’t even mind all the adds if the app was easy to navigate 0 stars.

reviews.title: Needs work…
reviews.text: So okay, I’ll start with the things I like about this app. I like the themes, they’re pretty cute and creative, and look well on your phone. I also like how the tutorials explain things well, and are easy to follow along with. However, this app has many issues, the first one being that there are way too many ads. Opening the app? Ad. Downloading anything? Ad. New page? Ad. Like okay I get that it’s reasonable to watch ads for gems, but half of the time it’s not for that. Another thing is that I was so excited about getting the icons for my phone, only to find they cost premium. You should not have to pay money to customize those. Yeah, I know there is a trial you can do, but even that feels a bit exhausting to do. This app has potential to become of four star rating for me, but only if some changes are made.
